SELECT D.SUBNAME_CH AS ITEMTYPE, B.SUBNAME_CH AS CAR, ITEMCODE, SPEC, ITEMNAME, C.SUBNAME_CH AS UNIT, DELDATE FROM T_MI_ITEM A INNER JOIN T_MI_TYPESUB B ON A.CARNO = B.SUBCODE AND B.TYPECODE = 'MI041' LEFT JOIN T_MI_TYPESUB C ON A.CMB_UNIT = C.SUBCODE AND C.TYPECODE = 'MI001' LEFT JOIN T_MI_TYPESUB D ON A.CMB_ITEMTYPE = D.SUBCODE AND D.TYPECODE = 'MI002' WHERE 1 = 1
AND DELDATE = ' '
AND UPPER(D.SUBNAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{itemtype}) || '%'
AND UPPER(B.SUBNAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{car}) || '%'
AND UPPER(ITEMCODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{itemcode}) || '%'
AND UPPER(SPEC) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{spec}) || '%'
AND UPPER(ITEMNAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{itemname}) || '%'
ORDER BY ITEMCODE
